recognize_zh: 這是一組流式細胞儀散點圖：紅色族群為 CD34+、HLA-DR 偏強、CD45 弱陽的異常骨髓母細胞，黑色族群為 CD117 強陽、HLA-DR 陰性的肥大細胞分化，綠色大族群為 CD203c+/CD123+、HLA-DR 陰性的嗜鹼性球；三群並存支持 CML 急性轉變合併明顯嗜鹼性球增生。
features: Multiparameter flow cytometry dot plots, color-coded populations (non-morphologic figure)
Red population: CD34-positive, HLA-DR bright, CD45 dim, CD7 positive, variable CD117 — abnormal myeloid blasts
Black population: CD117 bright, HLA-DR negative, CD203c partial/intermediate — mast cell–differentiated cells
Green population: CD45 moderate, CD123 positive, CD203c positive, HLA-DR negative, CD34 negative, CD117 negative — expanded basophils (gated)
Grey events: debris/non-viable or residual cells outside gates
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the CSF specimen shows three color-coded populations. An abnormal myeloid blast population (red) expresses bright CD34, HLA-DR, dim CD45, CD123 and aberrant CD7, with variable CD117. A CD117-bright, HLA-DR-negative subset (black) indicates mast cell differentiation, and a dominant CD123+/CD203c+/HLA-DR− population with moderate CD45 (green) represents basophils. In the setting of known CML, the findings are consistent with extramedullary (CNS) myeloid blast phase with prominent basophilic and mast cell differentiation.

ddx.vs: pDCs are CD123 bright and HLA-DR positive with CD4 and CD56 but lack CD203c, whereas the green basophil population here is HLA-DR negative and CD203c positive.
Neoplastic mast cells are CD117 bright/CD203c+ but CD123 weak and lack a coexisting CD34+ myeloblast population, which is present here in a CML context.
Flow may look similar; distinction rests on BCR::ABL1 detection and prior CML history rather than immunophenotype.
Aberrant CD7 on myeloid blasts is common and insufficient; MPAL requires cytoplasmic CD3 (T) or MPO with lineage-defining B markers, which are not shown.
